usefulness.rationale: The dossier has no content at all — only identity anchors (name, birth year/place, PepsiCo CEO role, education) and one retained but unextracted Business Roundtable bio source. A reader learns only the barest identifying facts: nothing about what he actually did at PepsiCo or Wimm-Bill-Dann/Frito-Lay before, no narrative, no statements with citations to assess. Since the dossier is empty, no overclaims can be cited; the two unjustified conclusions (acquisition-decider, locality) exist in the metadata but no dossier statement asserts them, so there is nothing to match. Remaining questions scored 0 because the empty dossier neither states nor implies what it does not know; it simply says nothing. Not ready for meeting prep beyond knowing his current title and education.
